source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of crossing over (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: Gametes bante waqt, meiosis I mein, homologous chromosomes crossing over se guzarte hain, jo linked genes ke naye milap (recombination) ka zimmedar hai. Do homologous chromosomes ke chromatids aik doosre ke saath qatar mein aate aur DNA ke hisse badalte hain; DNA strands waqai toot kar dobara jurte hain. Is ke baad homologous chromosomes alag ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar marahil; har chromatid par genes A, B aur C. 1, Homologous chromosomes: naranji chromosome (do sister chromatids A B C, aik jaise alleles) aur jamni (a b c). 2, Pairing aur segments ka tabadla: andar wale non-sister chromatids (wahi genes, mukhtalif alleles) C aur c wala hissa badalte hain. 3, Homologous jora alag hota hai. 4, Chromatids alag ho kar har aik gamete mein jata hai: A B C aur a b c parental, A B c aur a b C naye milap.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.11: Crossing over (kitab ki Figure 18.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Sister chromatids, Same alleles; Non-sister chromatids, Same genes, different alleles; Homologous chromosomes; Pairing and exchange of segments; Homologous pair separates; Chromatids separate & each enters a gamete; Parental combination; New combinations.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang dekhein: naranji chromosome maa ya baap mein se aik ka aur jamni doosre ka hai. Doosre marhale mein sirf andar wale do non-sister chromatids C wala hissa badalte hain. Is liye aakhir mein bahar wale do chromatids purane milap (A B C, a b c) aur andar wale do naye milap (A B c, a b C) le kar gametes mein jate hain.

Shamil chromatids par ab bhi wahi genes usi tarteeb mein hote hain, lekin un ke alleles nayi tarteeb mein aa jate hain. Jab yeh recombinant chromatids mukhtalif gametes mein jate hain to gametes ki bari variety banti hai, is liye crossing over genes ke naye milap laata aur genetic tanawwu ka zariya hai.

blocks.title: Do taash ki gaddiyan sochiye
blocks.text: Do taash ki gaddiyan saath saath sochiye, aik neeli pusht wali aur aik surkh, dono aik hi tarteeb mein. Dono ko aik hi jagah se kaat kar neeche ke aadhe badal dein: har card ki jagah wahi hai, lekin ab har gaddi mein neele aur surkh dono card hain.

blocks.prompt: AB aur ab chromatids wale cell mein A aur B ke darmiyan aik crossover hota hai. Kaun se gametes bante hain?
blocks.explanation: Do parental (AB aur ab) aur do recombinant (Ab aur aB).

items: Crossing over: meiosis I mein non-sister chromatids ka tabadla.
Wahi genes, wahi tarteeb, alleles ke naye milap: genetic variation.
